subject: financial_literacy
concept: Understanding the idea of a 'nest egg': saving and investing consistently over time to build long-term financial security
source_inspiration: original content, connecting to the Discipline and Agency Pillars — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student tracks a simulated small, regular contribution growing into a larger nest egg over many simulated years
exercise.pictorial: Student matches consistent small contributions over time to the size of nest egg they build
exercise.abstract: Student explains, in their own words, what a 'nest egg' is and why building one consistently over time matters

misconception_flags: believes a meaningful nest egg can only be built through one large windfall rather than consistent contributions over time

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
